title: Add Airtable-style timeline component with vertical, horizontal, and Gantt variants
body:
## Timeline Component Implementation

- [x] Create base UI timeline component in `packages/components/src/ui/timeline.tsx`
  - [x] Vertical timeline components (Timeline, TimelineItem, TimelineMarker, etc.)
  - [x] Horizontal timeline components
  - [x] Gantt/Airtable-style components (TimelineGantt, TimelineGanttBar, etc.)
- [x] Create timeline renderer in `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/timeline.tsx`
  - [x] Support for 3 variants: vertical, horizontal, gantt
  - [x] Date formatting options (short, long, ISO)
  - [x] Time scale support (day/week/month) for Gantt view
  - [x] Row-based grouping for Gantt view
  - [x] Interactive bars with click handlers
  - [x] Automatic date range calculation
  - [x] Color variants (default, success, warning, danger, info)
- [x] Register timeline component in `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/index.ts`
- [x] Build and verify the changes work correctly
- [x] Create comprehensive examples in prototype app showcasing all 3 timeline variants
- [x] Test and screenshot the timeline component
- [x] Add test coverage for timeline component registration
- [x] Create comprehensive documentation (TIMELINE.md)
- [x] Address code review feedback
  - [x] Extract date range calculation into separate helper function
  - [x] Replace magic number with named constant (MILLISECONDS_PER_WEEK)
  - [x] Remove unnecessary empty string from cn() call
- [x] Merge from main branch and resolve conflicts
- [x] All tests passing (11/11 component tests, all packages passing)

## Timeline Component Features

### 🎯 **Three Variants**

1. **Vertical Timeline** - Classic milestone-style timeline with icons and colored markers
2. **Horizontal Timeline** - Roadmap-style timeline for quarterly/period displays
3. **Gantt Timeline** - Full Airtable-style timeline with:
   - Date-based positioning
   - Multiple row/track support
   - Interactive bars with hover/click
   - Auto-calculated date ranges
   - Configurable time scales (day/week/month)

### 🎨 **Fully Customizable**

- 5 color variants: default, success, warning, danger, info
- Custom icons and emojis support
- Tailwind CSS classes for styling
- Date format options (short/long/ISO)
- Interactive item click handlers
- Custom content support via schemas

### 📦 **Production Ready**

- ✅ Built with TypeScript
- ✅ Full type safety
- ✅ Test coverage included (11/11 tests passing)
- ✅ Comprehensive documentation
- ✅ Working examples in prototype
- ✅ All builds passing
- ✅ Code review feedback addressed
- ✅ Merged with latest main branch

## Test Results

All tests passing successfully:
- **Core Package**: 1/1 tests passing
- **React Package**: 2/2 tests passing
- **Components Package**: 11/11 tests passing (includes timeline test)
- **Designer Package**: 6/6 tests passing

![Timeline Component](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d0c5d671-c05f-4889-8111-d69165efe3be)

The screenshot shows all three timeline variants in action:
- ✅ Vertical timeline with project milestones
- ✅ Horizontal timeline with quarterly roadmap
- ✅ Gantt-style timeline with multi-track project tasks

## Documentation

Full documentation is available in [TIMELINE.md](packages/components/src/renderers/complex/TIMELINE.md) including:
- Usage examples for all variants
- Complete prop documentation
- Advanced usage patterns
- Custom styling examples
- Interactive item handling
